answers.q1_what_did_you_play: Rapid Fire on Nibbit first, consuming the 3 Sparks, then Kaboom! on Nibbit, then Duck and Cover. This deals 23 damage and gains 5 Block.
answers.q2_other_line_considered: Rapid Fire, Kaboom!, then Rummage instead of Duck and Cover, keeping the same damage and drawing 3 cards but taking the full telegraphed attack.
answers.q3_what_it_gave_up: It gave up Rummage's draw of 3 cards in exchange for 5 Block against the incoming 12 damage.
answers.q4_different_intent: Yes. If Nibbit were not attacking, I would replace Duck and Cover with Rummage.
